newsitem.title: UK: Royal Bank says Direct Line H1 profits up.
newsitem.headline: Royal Bank says Direct Line H1 profits up.

text.p: Royal Bank of Scotland said on Wednesday that its Direct Line Insurance arm achieved a small increase in profits in the half year to March 31.
Pre-tax profits at Direct Line rose to eight million pounds ($13.1 million) from five million pounds in the same period last year.
During the six months, Direct Line Insurance continued its prudent approach of balancing market share with profitability, said the bank.
Lower average motor premium rates and volumes reduced profits by 15 million pounds.
General insurance earned premium income totalled 319 million pounds, a decrease of 12 million pounds or four percent, due to lower motor volumes and premium rates.
General insurance claims, net of reinsurance, fell to 253 million pounds from 295 million pounds in the same period last year.
Excluding the effect of reinsurance arrangements, claims costs were 12 million pounds lower than the prior year first half which was affected by exceptionally severe winter weather.
